meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 洗掉网文里的AI腔调，让文字自然像真人手写
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果写网文常被说像AI写的
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI-flavored phrasing from web novels so the prose feels authentically human.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and worry they sound AI-generated.

howto.what: 检测网文里的AI写作痕迹，按轻/中/重度分级处理，逐类替换高套路词、调整工整句式、让对话和情绪更自然；不改剧情，最后给出修改报告。
howto.when: 当你说“去AI味”“这篇太AI了”等，或输入 /story-deslop 命令时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这段网文去去AI味。
say.note: Claude 会先检测再返回改写后的文字。

say.text: 这段话太AI了，帮我改自然点。
say.note: 会附带修改统计和前后对比。

say.text: 只检查这段有没有AI味，先别改。
say.note: 只输出检测报告，不改动原文。

howto.what_en: Detects AI-sounding patterns in web fiction, rates severity, then removes them: swaps overused phrases, breaks rigid sentence patterns, makes dialogue and emotion sound more natural; plot stays unchanged. Provides a revision report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “去AI味” or “这篇太AI了”, or run the /story-deslop command.

say_en.text: Please remove the AI flavor from this web-novel passage.
say_en.note: Claude will first scan it, then return rewritten text.

say_en.text: This paragraph feels too AI-written; make it more natural.
say_en.note: You'll get a revision report with before/after.

say_en.text: Just check this passage for AI tells—don't edit it yet.
say_en.note: Only a detection report is returned; text stays untouched.
